preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must have BNB balance (from fees or previous transactions)

exploit_hint: As owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to marketingFeeReceiver, or call manualSend() to transfer all BNB to marketingFeeReceiver. Alternatively, use setFeeReceivers() to change fee receivers to attacker-controlled addresses before draining funds through normal fee accumulation.
